economic_rationale: Book equity capital cushion to absorb asset losses (%) – available across all eras (1984–2025).
Regulatory Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio (%), primary Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) trigger.
Total risk-based capital ratio (%) under Basel I/II/III capital standards.
Net equity buffer after deducting noncurrent loans, scaled by total assets (%).
Noncurrent loans (past due >=90d + nonaccrual) as % of gross loan portfolio.
Allowance for loan & lease losses (ALLL) as % of gross loans.
Reserve coverage ratio (% of noncurrent loans covered by loan-loss reserves).
Assets past due 90+ days and still accruing as % of total assets.
Nonaccrual loans & assets (severe credit distress) as % of total assets.
Other Real Estate Owned (foreclosed properties) as % of total assets.
Supervisory Texas Ratio: troubled assets vs. tangible capital + loss reserves (%).
Realized loan loss rate (net charge-offs as % of gross loans).
Annualized Return on Assets (%), core profitability metric.
Annualized Return on Equity (%), return to bank shareholders.
Net Interest Margin (%), core lending spread efficiency.
Operating efficiency ratio: noninterest overhead expense per dollar of operating revenue (%).
Unadjusted net profit generation relative to asset base (%).
Quarterly organic capital accumulation (retained earnings + net capital accretion % of assets).
Credit loss provision expense burden relative to total assets (%).
Reliance on wholesale/brokered deposits (% of total deposits) – flight-prone funding.
Cash, due from banks, and investment securities as % of total assets.
Net loans to total deposits (%) – measures illiquidity and funding stretch.
Share of balance sheet funded by deposits vs. non-deposit borrowings (%).
Domestic deposit share of total deposits (%).
Real estate loan concentration (% of gross loans) – exposure to property cycles.
Commercial & industrial (C&I) loan share (% of gross loans).
Consumer loan share (% of gross loans).
Effective deposit interest expense rate (%) – sensitivity to interest rate hikes.
Log of total assets (in $ thousands) – captures bank scale and diversification.
1-year (4Q) asset growth rate (%) – rapid expansion often precedes credit losses.
1-year (4Q) gross loan growth rate (%) – aggressive lending indicator.
4-quarter change in NPL ratio (percentage points) – credit deterioration velocity.
4-quarter change in equity-to-asset ratio (percentage points) – capital erosion speed.
4-quarter change in ROA (percentage points) – earnings trajectory.
4-quarter backward rolling mean of ROA (%) – smoothed earnings power.
4-quarter backward rolling standard deviation of ROA – earnings instability/risk.
4-quarter backward rolling mean of Net Interest Margin (%).
